records.summary_zh: 帖主持有 Google AI Pro，约半年后重新打开 Antigravity 时，发现访问权限已经停用。作者不知道限制从何时开始，也不清楚具体原因。10 月 29 日回帖说，提交申诉、更新应用并重新登录后，仍然无法使用。
records.summary_en: A Google AI Pro subscriber reopened Antigravity after roughly six months and found access disabled. They did not know when the restriction began or why. In an October 29 follow-up, they said they still could not use it after appealing, updating the app and signing in again.
records.uncertainty_zh: 原帖不是独立核实，不能推断10月29日之后的结果。
records.uncertainty_en: The account decision and any outcome after October 29 remain unverified.
records.source_visibility: Original post and author follow-ups were readable; no private records were checked.

records.date_note: The author gives November 14 in UTC-03:00 without a time; no Beijing-time date is inferred.
records.summary_zh: 11 月 14 日，作者在开发过程中遇到官方 Antigravity 客户端服务停用，界面提示违反服务条款，工作因此中断。作者随后提交申诉，并在 11 月 15 日回帖说，官方应用仍然无法使用。
records.summary_en: On November 14, the author’s development work was interrupted when the official Antigravity client displayed a service-disabled notice citing a Terms of Service violation. They appealed and, on November 15, said the official app still did not work.
records.uncertainty_zh: 作者所述第三方使用经历不等于官方确认原因；不摘录方法或操作链接。
records.uncertainty_en: Reported third-party use does not prove causation. No methods or operational links are reproduced.
records.source_visibility: Original issue and author follow-up were readable; repository labels do not verify the account decision.

records.codename_zh: 能登录但模型仍不可用
records.date_note: The initial incident date is unstated; the forum display does not identify a timezone.
records.summary_zh: 帖主此前无法登录 Antigravity，提交申诉后可以重新登录了，但模型调用仍然提示服务停用，连一条简单消息也发不出去。11 月 10 日发帖时，作者正在寻求继续处理这个问题的方法。
records.summary_en: After appealing an Antigravity restriction, the author could sign in again, but model requests still returned a service-disabled notice, even for a simple message. Their November 10 post asked how to resolve the remaining access problem.
records.uncertainty_zh: 登录恢复不等于模型权限恢复；通用论坛答复不能确认具体处置原因。
records.uncertainty_en: Restored sign-in does not establish restored model access; the general forum response does not verify causation.
records.source_visibility: Original post and a November 11 general response were readable.
